summary: The sole medium finding is confirmed: actual queue regeneration duplicates the shared design/review IDs and overwrites Martin’s accepted brief. The live issue still retains Martin’s brief. No mathematical correction to the extraction is established.

findings.reason: Confirmed by reading the unmodified make_queue.py and independently executing its actual main with --dry-run in a disposable public-repository input snapshot. accepted_routes selects all four accepted routes to ArithmeticDynamicsPartIIMarkoff: Chen route 2 (13 references), Gamburd–Magee–Ronan route 2 (18), Martin route 2 (35), and Ghosh–Sarnak route 5 (5). Their route kind, parent, title and area agree; all 71 source-qualified references are distinct. The generator appends a design tuple per route. Its list-comprehension filter checks only the pre-existing built-in designs, not earlier members of paper_designs; add then appends each job while replacing prompts[path]. The completed dry run therefore has four copies of DESIGN-ArithmeticDynamicsPartIIMarkoff and four copies of its review. The final prompt contains the complete Ghosh–Sarnak brief and five references, no item references from the other three routes, and neither PAPER-MARTIN-25/20 nor the extended-Penner-weight instruction. Repeated after refreshing the changed queue input at e056b0d0a8966511f4da3b48457296585777758a with the same result. Live issue #1700 still contains Martin’s complete brief and 35 references; this is a regeneration defect, not evidence that that live issue or an implemented blueprint has already lost them. Medium severity and the proposed coalescing fix are appropriate: create one design/review pair per destination, validate compatible metadata, retain every source-qualified brief and item list, and add a regression asserting both unique job IDs and preservation of all 71 references. Preserve common-carrier and convention distinctions rather than creating competing roadmap IDs. The repair belongs in the queue generator and its regression tests, followed by normal prompt/issue regeneration; no mathematical extraction rewrite is justified by this finding.
